chat.title: AI AGENT CONVERSATION
chat.inputPlaceholder: Instruct the AI Agent (e.g. 'Check balance', 'Transfer 50 AGNT to 0x...')
chat.welcomeGreeting:
**Welcome to AI Agent with Blockchain Tools!**

I am your autonomous on-chain assistant secured by the **Guardrail & Policy Engine**.

You can query balances, check token info, simulate dry-runs, or submit transfer requests. All write operations will be validated against safety policies and presented for your explicit approval.

timeline.emptyDesc: Send a natural-language prompt to observe the 9-stage workflow in real-time.
